files_summary.notion_pages.json: page_id -> {id,title,blocks[*],parent}. 11 pages (page_home, page_weekly, page_weekly_w13, 8D report, audit plan, calibration, production, procurement, CAPA index, inventory) with heading/paragraph/bulleted_list/to_do blocks; parent refs (workspace/page_id/database_id) consistent with notion_databases ids.
files_summary.notion_databases.json: db_title -> {id,schema,rows[{id,...}]}. 4 databases: Defects (20 lot rows), Suppliers (5), CAPA (7), Inventory (10). IDs deterministic (db_defects + uuid5). Schema property->type consistent with row fields.

tool_schemas.name: read_page
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a Notion page by its page_id and returns the page’s title and the blocks currently on that page. It refuses requests with a missing or malformed page_id, or when the page cannot be found. It also refuses access when the page isn’t shared with or accessible to the ForgeSight Quality Hub workspace integration.

tool_schemas.name: query_db
tool_schemas.description: Finds the Notion database with the given db_title and returns all rows currently in that database. It refuses requests with a missing/blank db_title, when no database with that title can be found, or when multiple databases match and the title is not unique. It also refuses access if the matched database isn’t shared with or accessible to the ForgeSight Quality Hub workspace integration.

tool_schemas.name: add_database_row
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new row (page) in the Notion database identified by db_title and returns the created row with its properties. It refuses requests when db_title is missing/blank, when the database can’t be found (or the title is ambiguous), or when the database isn’t accessible to the ForgeSight Quality Hub integration. It also refuses rows whose provided properties don’t match the database schema (unknown property names, invalid value types, or missing values required by Notion for the target schema).

tool_schemas.name: update_db_row
tool_schemas.description: Updates the specified database row/page by page_id with the provided property values and returns the updated row properties. It refuses requests with a missing or malformed page_id, when the row can’t be found, or when the row isn’t accessible to the ForgeSight Quality Hub integration. It also refuses updates that don’t conform to the row’s database schema (unknown properties, invalid types, or attempts to set values that conflict with the property configuration).

tool_schemas.name: append_blocks
tool_schemas.description: Appends the provided blocks to the end of the Notion page identified by page_id and returns the page blocks after the append. It refuses requests with a missing/malformed page_id or a missing/non-array blocks value, or when the page can’t be found. It also refuses access when the page isn’t accessible to the ForgeSight Quality Hub integration, and refuses blocks that are not valid Notion block objects for the target page.

tool_schemas.name: create_page
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new Notion page with the given title and returns the created page, including its id and title. It refuses requests with a missing/blank title or a title that cannot be accepted by Notion. It also refuses creation when the ForgeSight Quality Hub integration does not have permission to create pages in the configured workspace location.

tool_schemas.name: create_database
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new Notion database with the provided title and properties_schema and returns the created database, including its id and schema. It refuses requests with a missing/blank title, a missing/empty properties_schema, or a schema that contains unsupported property definitions or invalid type mappings. It also refuses creation when the ForgeSight Quality Hub integration does not have permission to create databases in the configured workspace location, or when the requested title conflicts in a way Notion won’t accept.

metadata.name: ForgeSight Quality Hub
metadata.description: A Notion-backed quality control workspace for managing inspections, supplier oversight, and corrective actions with structured databases and page-based documentation.
